title: feat(plugin-webhooks)!: declared webhooks are held per namespace, each holder dispatched and switched as its own (ADR-0150 child B, webhook family 2/3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgV1Wp8HYsu2keXwrYrCpGHZ)_

epic:#31527#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZu9RRx2o8sFUUpEPU

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：两个不同命名空间的包现在可以各自声明同名 webhook，每个包的声明按（包，名）各自订阅、各自开关、各自投递；包的声明产生的投递 `ref_id` 改为 `declared:PKG/NAME`（环境自己的声明仍是 `declared:NAME`）；新增限定启用门 `POST /security/_activation/webhook/:ns/:name`；两个持有者时，裸读 `/meta/webhook/NAME`、`/published` 和裸启用门都答 409 并列出两者（启用门原来答 503）。第 2 轮：被禁用的包不算服务中的持有者（不派发、不可重投递，但账本归属仍按全部持有者算）；`ref_id` 上限 128 → 384，`dedup_key` 超过 191 时用 sha256 摘要，原来能投递的名字仍能投递；升级影响报告按（包，名）读。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 child B 的 webhook 部分（#31699 三个 PR 中的第 2 个）。第 0 步实测：只翻三个集合而不改读取方，另一命名空间装进同名 webhook 后，两个持有者都会悄悄停发。所以先把派发器、开关账本、启用门、重投递守卫、名字守卫都改为按（包，名）读，再翻集合。
- 风险与回滚：收窄两处，已声明，工作区内受影响的调用方为 0：两个持有者的裸 `/meta/webhook/NAME`（及其 `/published`）由先注册者改为 409；按 `ref_id = 'declared:NAME'` 选投递行的消费方，升级后的新行要改为匹配 `declared:PKG/NAME`。`ref_id` 加宽在已有的 PostgreSQL/MySQL 库上要 `os migrate apply`（`safe` 的 `widen_varchar`），执行前，超过 128 字符的新引用会在插入时被拒（见文末开放问题 2）。滚动升级期间，旧节点重投递新形状的行会 fail closed（拒绝，不会发错持有者）；跨升级同一 webhook 的投递之间不保证顺序。只有一个持有者时，除新投递的 `ref_id` 外，所有答案不变。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/declared-webhooks.ts`（`packageScopedRegistryOf` 的 served / every、`slotsOf`、`webhookSlotSwitch`、`DeclaredWebhookSource`），`packages/runtime/src/domains/catalog-activation.ts`（`resolveQualifiedWebhook`），`packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/redeliver-guard.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-webhooks exec vitest run src/declared-webhooks.test.ts` 与 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/catalog-activation-door.test.ts`，应全绿；"one declaration per (package, name) slot"（含 "a disabled co-holder"）和 "a declared webhook two packages declare" 两节逐条钉住。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地；文末四个开放问题由席位裁定。

Part of #31699

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — two answers move for a caller that worked before. (1) The bare `GET /meta/webhook/NAME` of a name two packages hold, and its published read `GET /meta/webhook/NAME/published` (which asks the bare item read for the item's package), are refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (`ambiguous-in-environment`, naming both), where they served the first registered package's declaration; before this change that state existed only for a clash the cold boot sealed with a warning. (2) A declared webhook a package ships is subscribed, and its new deliveries are written, under `ref_id = declared:PKG/NAME`, where they carried `declared:NAME`; a consumer that selects deliveries by `ref_id = 'declared:NAME'` no longer matches the ones written after the upgrade. First-party callers in either position: 0. Widened beside them: the engine's package door, item seam and cold-boot seal admit a second package holder of a webhook name that declares another namespace, and the dispatcher, which subscribed neither holder of such a name, subscribes each one.
Metadata-protocol: added (a second package's webhook declaration of a name another namespace holds is now accepted, where it was refused `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`; no key, value or requirement an author writes against is refused or tightened)
Skills-docs: none — `content/docs/automation/webhooks.mdx` §3.0 is updated in this PR (the `ref_id` shape and the namespace door beside the bare one; seat-approved addition, 04:03Z); no published skill teaches a declared webhook's name scope, its `ref_id` or the activation door (`grep -rn "declared:\|_activation/webhook\|sys_http_delivery\|ref_id" skills/`: one hit, `skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md:79`, a comment about published keys, unrelated).

**Narrowing: yes**, first-party callers **0** (measured). (1) No first-party package pair holds one webhook name across two packages; the full dogfood battery, which boots the showcase, CRM and every example app, is green with the refusal on. (2) No in-tree consumer selects `sys_http_delivery` by a literal `declared:NAME`: the four dogfood suites that read a delivery's `ref_id` are moved to the new shape in this PR (`upgrade-18x-harness`, `webhook-materialization`, `wall-declared-webhook-deployment-wide`, `bare-name-one-holder-flow-family`), and the CLI's 18.x ownership ceremony keeps writing `declared:NAME` (seat ruling Q4), which the redelivery guard still reads.

This is the second of three PRs for #31699: email_template (#32214, merged), webhook here, then connector. Only `webhook` joins `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` here.

## Seat rulings this PR implements

Comment [6813532941](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/31699#issuecomment-6813532941):

- **Q1 = A.** A ledger row naming no package, for a name two packages hold, is no holder's own (ADR-0150 D4). Switched off, it keeps every holder with no row of its own off. Switched on, it turns none on. The reader says so once per name, naming both. This is the flow engine's rule from #31696.
- **Q2.** All three type sets flip, the metadata slotted store included.
- **Q3.** The file surface below.
- **Q4.** The CLI 18.x ceremony keeps writing `declared:NAME`, pinned.
- **Q5.** Branch `claude/project-thread-3giljf`, a new draft PR, `Part of #31699`.

Round 2, comment [6816940784](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/31699#issuecomment-6816940784) (after CR 6816920433 and red-line 6816929999):

- **R2-A (red line 1).** A disabled package is no holder for what serves or dispatches; a durable read counts every holder. The readers and their reading are listed under "Two slices" below.
- **R2-B.** `origin/main` merged (no rebase). #32548's boot-pass pins iterate `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY ∩ PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES`; a webhook CONTROL pins that the boot pass registers and writes no webhook row. How a stored package-scoped webhook row loads at boot is measured and pinned for one and two holders. `webhook` is not added to the type registry.
- **R2-C (red line 3).** Every name whose `declared:NAME` fitted still delivers: `ref_id`'s cap is widened, the `dedup_key` cap was measured to bind first, and a key past it is digested.
- **R2-D.** The upgrade impact report reads webhooks by `(package, name)`; the remedies name the namespace address; row (1) names `/published`, pinned.

## Two slices (R2-A)

| Reader | Reads | Why |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `slotsOf` slots, `list()` (the dispatcher) | served | a disabled package's webhooks are not dispatched (#25308's listing) |
| `declaredWebhookNamed` (the bare resolver: `GET /meta`, the bare activation door, the name guard) | served | the bare name answers the enabled holder alone |
| `declaredWebhookAt` (the redelivery veto) | served | a `declared:PKG/NAME` delivery of a disabled package is refused, naming the package |
| `bindDeclaredWebhookNameGuard` | served | the conflict names the served holders' addresses |
| the qualified door's slots, the bare door's entry | served | an all-disabled namespace answers `404` |
| `webhookSlotSwitch` (ledger row ownership), `reportUnownedRows` | every holder | a row naming no package under two holders stays no holder's own while one is disabled |
| the door's `adoptPackageless` (the reader's new `holdersOf`) | every holder | a write for the enabled holder never takes over that row |
| the boot backfill (`backfillActivationLedgerAtBoot`) | every holder | already read the raw registry; unchanged |

## File surface

Claim (seat Q3): `packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/declared-webhooks.ts`, `auto-enqueuer.ts`, `redeliver-guard.ts`; `packages/runtime/src/domains/catalog-activation.ts`; the three sets (`packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`, `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-read.ts`, `packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts`) and `packages/objectql/src/bare-name-one-holder.ts`'s doc; their tests; the dogfood files; the changeset.

Seat-approved additions:

- `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts` (the four-segment mount) and `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts` (its server-only row): Claim amendment [6813666631](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/31699#issuecomment-6813666631).
- `content/docs/automation/webhooks.mdx` §3.0, scoped to the two sentences this PR makes false (the `ref_id` shape, and the namespace door beside the bare one): approved by the seat at 04:03Z.
- Round 2, by the ruling (6816940784): `packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts` (R2-B); `packages/objectql/src/webhook-stored-row-boot-hydration.test.ts` (new, R2-B's boot path); `packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/http-delivery.object.ts` and `packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/vitest.config.ts` (R2-C: the cap, and a source alias so the plugin's tests read the service's source rather than a stale `dist`; the alias registry in `scripts/check-test-source-alias.mjs` narrows to match, as its gate requires); `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/upgrade-impact-report.ts` and its test (R2-D); `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts` (R2-D, `/published`). Gate-forced: `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` records the new boot-hydration test's `findOne` double (`--write`).

## Tests

- plugin-webhooks `declared-webhooks.test.ts`, new describe "one declaration per (package, name) slot (ADR-0150 D3/D4/D5, #31699)", 12 pins. `auto-enqueuer-disabled-report.test.ts`: the CONTROL expects the `my_app` slot's ref.
- runtime `catalog-activation-door.test.ts`, new describe "a declared webhook two packages declare (ADR-0150, #31699)", 7 pins. `meta-write-org-scope.test.ts`: its unmapped type is now `queue`, because `webhook` now has a package-scoped resolver.
- objectql: e8 readers (`WIRED_SINCE` gains `webhook`, plus a webhook `/meta` describe), ai-family (`SWITCHED` gains `webhook`), flow-family (the switch pin, "[#31699 PR 2, FROM 422 TO admitted]", and the CONTROL now `['flow', 'connector']`).
- dogfood `bare-name-one-holder-flow-family.dogfood.test.ts`: the cold-boot warning names only flow and connector; a nested describe boots two holders of `qa_shared_hook` and pins: each slot is off as shipped; the bare door answers 409; `alpha/qa_shared_hook` answers 200, and alpha alone is dispatched, with `ref_id declared:com.qa.bare.alpha/qa_shared_hook`, to `https://hooks.example/alpha`; theta installs as a third slot. `upgrade-18x-harness`, `webhook-materialization` and `wall-declared-webhook-deployment-wide` read the new `ref_id` (the harness's ceremony re-source at line 242 keeps `declared:NAME`, Q4).

Round 2:

- plugin-webhooks `declared-webhooks.test.ts`, nested describe "a disabled co-holder (#31699 round 2)", every two-holder pin run in both registration orders: "[FROM delivered TO withheld]" (dispatch, the bare read, the redelivery veto naming the disabled package, `holdersOf`, and re-enabling resumes delivery), "[FROM A's switch TO no holder's]", the name guard judging the served set, CONTROL both enabled, CONTROL a lone disabled holder; beside it, the remedies pin and its CONTROL (the environment's own declaration keeps the bare address).
- runtime `catalog-activation-door.test.ts`: "[FROM adopted TO beside it]" (bare and namespace address), CONTROL every holder is one (adopted, D8), "B disabled and alone" (`404`, nothing written). `meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts`: the bare read and `/published` of a two-holder name answer `409` naming both, the namespace address reads one; CONTROL one holder (`200`; `/published` `404`, nothing published).
- metadata `database-loader.test.ts`: `BOOT_PASS_READS = UNBUNDLED ∩ DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` drives #32548's boot-pass cases; "the types are taken from the tree" pins that the intersection is every slotted type but `webhook`; CONTROL webhook: the boot pass registers none of its rows and writes nothing.
- objectql `webhook-stored-row-boot-hydration.test.ts` (new): a real `SchemaRegistry` and `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.loadMetaFromDb`. CONTROL one holder: a row naming it, or naming no package (D8), is its slot, and no environment holder appears. Two holders, both orders: a row naming one holder is that holder's slot, and the other keeps its shipped declaration.
- plugin-webhooks `webhook-delivery-real-sql-driver.test.ts`, describe at the old 128 boundary, one holder (`declared:NAME` exactly 128): "[FROM lost TO delivered]" (`ref_id` stored whole as `declared:PKG/NAME`, the dedup key a `sha256:` digest), CONTROL a short name keeps the plain key, and the 191 / 192 boundary unit.
- plugin-security `upgrade-impact-report.test.ts`: "[FROM one TO each]", "[FROM no finding TO orphan]", CONTROL one holder.

**Red on main, then green (round 1).**

- plugin-webhooks: 9 of the 12 new pins are red on main. The three green on main are the mixed-version pin, the D8 one-holder pin and the listed-twice CONTROL, each of which pins an answer main already gives.
- runtime: 4 of the 7 are red on main, the four that use the namespace address (main answers `400` to four segments). The bare-address 409 pin passes on main, because its fake reader carries `refusal`; the `503 → 409` move is pinned in plugin-webhooks (the error's `refusal`, A3) and in the dogfood door, which boots the real reader.

**Ablations**, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (mutation landed, restored to the HEAD blob with an empty `git diff HEAD`):

- A1, the ref id without the package: 2 red (one holder dispatched as `declared:PKG/NAME`; FROM neither TO both).
- A2, a slot's own row ignored (`own = undefined` in `webhookSlotSwitch`): 8 red (the three existing ledger pins and the existing redelivery refusal of a webhook switched off through the ledger; the new ledger slot pin, Q1, D8, and the slot-exact redelivery).
- A3, `refusal` dropped from `DeclaredWebhookAmbiguousError`: 1 red (the bare read's 409 carrying the refusal).
- A4, the door's webhook store back to name addressing: 2 red (the namespace door's own row; Q1's row beside the package-less one).
- A5, the served slice read as every holder (`served = every`): 6 red ("[FROM delivered TO withheld]", "[FROM A's switch TO no holder's]" and the served-set name guard, each in both orders).
- A6, ledger ownership read from the served slots: 2 red ("[FROM A's switch TO no holder's]", both orders).
- A7, the door's `adoptPackageless` counting the served holders: 1 red ("[FROM adopted TO beside it]").
- A8, `ref_id` back to 128: 1 red ("[FROM lost TO delivered]").
- A9, no dedup digest: 2 red ("[FROM lost TO delivered]"; the 191 / 192 boundary).
- A10, the report's ledger rows judged by the bare shipper: 1 red ("[FROM no finding TO orphan]").
- A11, the report's shippers without the listed webhooks: 1 red ("[FROM one TO each]").

Two round-2 pins pin a path this PR does not change, so they have no ablation: the R2-B boot-hydration pins (`loadMetaFromDb` binds the rows the same way with the three type sets at `origin/main`'s, measured), and the `/published` `409` (main's bare item read already refused a registry holding both items; what this PR moves is that such a registry is now admitted).

## Acceptance notes

- **Landing order** (seat): after #31696 PR-3, #31700 (#32513) and #32183 (#32497), merging `origin/main` after each. `catalog-activation.ts` is also touched by #31696 PR-3 and #32306. On #32306's overlap in `registerSecurityActivationRoutes`, whichever lands second merges that function by hand and keeps both changes.
- **Upgrade (ADR-0150 D10).** Declared subscriptions live in memory only, so nothing stored is re-keyed. After the upgrade a one-holder declaration is subscribed once, as `declared:PKG/NAME`, and an event is delivered once (pinned in the plugin and in the dogfood upgrade harness, 2b). A delivery written before the upgrade keeps `declared:NAME`, and its redelivery reaches the one holder as before. A package-less ledger row is bound to the one holder by the existing boot backfill (`activation-ledger-backfill.ts`).
